# glinet_firewall_zones (Data Source)

Get the names of the firewall zones (`firewall.get_zone_list`). They are the values for `external_zone` and `internal_zone` of `glinet_firewall_port_forward` and for `source_zone` and `destination_zone` of `glinet_firewall_rule`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_firewall_zones" "zones" {}

output "external_zones" {
  value = data.glinet_firewall_zones.zones.external_zones
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `external_zones` (List of String) External zones (`externals`).
- `internal_zones` (List of String) Internal zones (`internals`).
